description: Hardware SPI master controller on the ESP32-S3 SoC (SPI2 or SPI3). Chips on it (displays) name it as their bus and each takes its own chip select.

fields.label: SPI controller
fields.description: ESP32-S3 hardware SPI controller; SPI2 is the fastest on its own pins (GPIO 10 to 13)

fields.label: SCLK pin
fields.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO pin for the clock

fields.label: MOSI pin
fields.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO pin for data to the chips (optional if they only send)

fields.label: MISO pin
fields.description: ESP32-S3 GPIO pin for data from the chips (optional if they only listen)

fields.label: Largest transfer
fields.description: The most bytes in one transfer; at least a display's largest transfer (12800 by default)
